npc.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر! تَفَضَّلْ، كَيْفَ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أُسَاعِدَكَ الْيَوْم؟
npc.en: Good morning! Please come forward, how can I help you today?
segs: I help you (to a man, after an)

choices.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور. أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُرْسِلَ هٰذَا الطَّرْدَ إِلَى عَائِلَتِي فِي شِيكَاغُو، فِيهِ هَدَايَا مِنْ مِصْر.
choices.en: Good morning. I want to send this parcel to my family in Chicago; there are gifts from Egypt in it.
choices.feedback: Good: صَبَاحُ النُّور answers صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر, and after أَنْ the verb ends in -a: أُرْسِلَ.

choices.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور. أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُرْسِلُ هٰذَا الطَّرْدَ إِلَى عَائِلَتِي فِي شِيكَاغُو.
choices.en: Good morning. I want to send this parcel to my family in Chicago (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: After أَنْ ('to') the present verb ends in -a, not -u: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُرْسِلَ.

npc.ar: حَسَنًا، ضَعْهُ عَلَى الْمِيزَانِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. لَحْظَة، الصُّنْدُوقُ غَيْرُ مُغْلَقٍ جَيِّدًا، وَهُوَ مُمَزَّق مِنْ هٰذَا الْجَانِب.
npc.en: All right, put it on the scale, please. One moment, the box isn't closed properly, and it's torn on this side.

choices.ar: آسِف، هٰذَا صُنْدُوق قَدِيم مِنَ الْبَيْت. هَلْ تَبِيعُونَ صَنَادِيقَ هُنَا فِي مَكْتَبِ الْبَرِيد؟
choices.en: Sorry, this is an old box from home. Do you sell boxes here at the post office?
choices.feedback: Good: تَبِيعُونَ is plural, because you ask about the post office, not only this clerk.

choices.ar: آسِفَة، هٰذَا صُنْدُوق قَدِيم مِنَ الْبَيْت. هَلْ تَبِيعُونَ صَنَادِيقَ هُنَا فِي مَكْتَبِ الْبَرِيد؟
choices.en: Sorry, this is an old box from home. Do you sell boxes here at the post office? (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: آسِفَة is said by a woman. Faisal is a man: آسِف.

npc.ar: نَعَم، عِنْدَنَا صُنْدُوق قَوِيّ مَعَ شَرِيط لَاصِق بِثَلَاثِينَ جُنَيْهًا. سَأُغْلِقُهُ لَكَ بِنَفْسِي.
npc.en: Yes, we have a strong box with sticky tape for thirty pounds. I'll close it for you myself.

choices.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا! كَمْ يَزِنُ الطَّرْدُ الْآنَ؟ فِيهِ تَمْر وَوِشَاح لِأُمِّي.
choices.en: Thank you very much! How much does the parcel weigh now? There are dates and a scarf for my mother in it.
choices.feedback: Good: طَرْد is masculine, so the verb is يَزِنُ (it weighs) with y-.

choices.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا! كَمْ تَزِنُ الطَّرْدُ الْآنَ؟
choices.en: Thank you very much! How much does the parcel weigh now? (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: تَزِنُ is for a feminine subject. طَرْد (parcel) is masculine: كَمْ يَزِنُ الطَّرْدُ؟

npc.ar: يَزِنُ أَرْبَعَةَ كِيلُوغْرَامَات بِالضَّبْط. هَلْ تُرِيدُ الْبَرِيدَ الْعَادِيَّ أَمِ الْبَرِيدَ السَّرِيع؟
npc.en: It weighs exactly four kilos. Do you want normal post or express post?

choices.ar: مَا الْفَرْق؟ عِيدُ مِيلَادِ أُمِّي بَعْدَ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّام، وَأُرِيدُ أَنْ تَصِلَ الْهَدَايَا قَبْلَهُ.
choices.en: What's the difference? My mother's birthday is in ten days, and I want the gifts to arrive before it.
choices.feedback: A good question before you choose. Note تَصِلَ: the gifts are a plural of things, so the verb is feminine.

choices.ar: السَّرِيع إِذًا، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. أُمِّي تَنْتَظِرُ التَّمْرَ الْمِصْرِيَّ كُلَّ سَنَة!
choices.en: Express then, please. My mother waits for Egyptian dates every year!
choices.feedback: Good: he asked 'this or that?' (أَمِ), and you choose one of the two.

choices.ar: نَعَم، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
choices.en: Yes, please.
choices.feedback: He asks 'normal or express?' (أَمِ), so 'yes' does not answer. Choose one: الْعَادِيّ or السَّرِيع.

npc.ar: الْبَرِيدُ الْعَادِيّ يَأْخُذُ ثَلَاثَةَ أَسَابِيع تَقْرِيبًا، وَهُوَ بِثَمَانِمِئَةِ جُنَيْه. السَّرِيعُ يَصِلُ فِي خَمْسَةِ أَيَّام، لٰكِنَّهُ بِأَلْف جُنَيْه.
npc.en: Normal post takes about three weeks and costs eight hundred pounds. Express arrives in five days, but it costs a thousand pounds.

choices.ar: السَّرِيع إِذًا، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. أُمِّي تَنْتَظِرُ التَّمْرَ الْمِصْرِيَّ كُلَّ سَنَة!
choices.en: Express then, please. My mother waits for Egyptian dates every year!
choices.feedback: Right choice: express arrives in five days, before the birthday in ten days.

choices.ar: الْعَادِيّ إِذًا، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
choices.en: Normal post then, please.
choices.feedback: Good Arabic, but normal post takes about three weeks (ثَلَاثَةَ أَسَابِيع), and the birthday is in ten days. Choose السَّرِيع.

npc.ar: حَسَنًا. اِمْلَأْ هٰذِهِ الِاسْتِمَارَةَ لِلْجَمَارِك: اُكْتُبْ مُحْتَوَيَاتِ الطَّرْدِ وَقِيمَتَهَا بِالْجُنَيْه.
npc.en: All right. Fill in this customs form: write the contents of the parcel and their value in pounds.

choices.ar: كَتَبْتُ: تَمْر وَوِشَاح مِنَ الْقُطْن، وَالْقِيمَةُ خَمْسُمِئَةِ جُنَيْه. وَأُرِيدُ أَيْضًا طَوَابِعَ لِثَلَاثِ بِطَاقَاتٍ بَرِيدِيَّة.
choices.en: I've written: dates and a cotton scarf, and the value is five hundred pounds. I'd also like stamps for three postcards.
choices.feedback: Good: بِطَاقَة is feminine, so 'three' has no ة: لِثَلَاثِ بِطَاقَاتٍ. After hundreds the noun is singular: خَمْسُمِئَةِ جُنَيْه.

choices.ar: كَتَبْتُ: تَمْر وَوِشَاح مِنَ الْقُطْن، وَالْقِيمَةُ خَمْسُمِئَةِ جُنَيْه. وَأُرِيدُ أَيْضًا طَوَابِعَ لِثَلَاثَةِ بِطَاقَاتٍ بَرِيدِيَّة.
choices.en: I've written: dates and a cotton scarf, and the value is five hundred pounds. I'd also like stamps for three postcards (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: With 3 to 10 the number takes the opposite gender. بِطَاقَة (card) is feminine, so 'three' drops the ة: لِثَلَاثِ بِطَاقَاتٍ.

npc.ar: فَيْصَل، نَحْتَاجُ إِلَى أَرُزّ وَدَجَاج وَخُضَار وَزَبَادِي لِعَشَاءِ الْأَصْدِقَاءِ اللَّيْلَة.
npc.en: Faisal, we need rice, chicken, vegetables and yoghurt for dinner with our friends tonight.

choices.ar: الْأَرُزّ هُنَا عَلَى الرَّفِّ الثَّانِي. نَأْخُذُ كِيسًا كَبِيرًا أَمْ كِيسَيْنِ صَغِيرَيْنِ؟
choices.en: The rice is here on the second shelf. Shall we take one big bag or two small bags?
choices.feedback: Good: the adjective follows the dual: كِيسَيْنِ صَغِيرَيْنِ, both with -ayni.

choices.ar: الْأَرُزّ هُنَا عَلَى الرَّفِّ الثَّانِي. لٰكِنْ أَيْنَ الْبَهَارَات؟ لَا أَرَاهَا فِي أَيِّ مَكَان.
choices.en: The rice is here on the second shelf. But where are the spices? I can't see them anywhere.
choices.feedback: Good: plurals of things count as feminine singular, so 'them' is -hā: لَا أَرَاهَا.

choices.ar: الْأَرُزّ هُنَا عَلَى الرَّفِّ الثَّانِي. نَأْخُذُ كِيسًا كَبِيرًا أَمْ كِيسَيْنِ صَغِيرًا؟
choices.en: The rice is here on the second shelf. Shall we take one big bag or two small bags? (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: After a dual noun the adjective is dual too: كِيسَيْنِ صَغِيرَيْنِ, not صَغِيرًا.

npc.ar: انْظُرْ، هُنَاكَ عَرْض: كِيسَانِ بِسِعْرِ كِيس وَاحِد! سَنَأْخُذُ الْعَرْضَ طَبْعًا.
npc.en: Look, there's an offer: two bags for the price of one! We'll take the offer, of course.

choices.ar: أَخَذْتُ الدَّجَاجَ وَالطَّمَاطِمَ وَالْخِيَار. لٰكِنْ أَيْنَ الْبَهَارَات؟ لَا أَرَاهَا فِي أَيِّ مَكَان.
choices.en: I've got the chicken, the tomatoes and the cucumbers. But where are the spices? I can't see them anywhere.
choices.feedback: Good: الْبَهَارَات is a plural of things, so 'them' is -hā: لَا أَرَاهَا.

choices.ar: أَخَذْتُ الدَّجَاجَ وَالطَّمَاطِمَ وَالْخِيَار. لٰكِنْ أَيْنَ الْبَهَارَات؟ لَا أَرَاهُمْ فِي أَيِّ مَكَان.
choices.en: I've got the chicken, the tomatoes and the cucumbers. But where are the spices? I can't see them anywhere (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: -hum is only for people. Plurals of things are treated as feminine singular: لَا أَرَاهَا.

npc.ar: الْبَهَارَاتُ فِي الْمَمَرِّ الْخَامِس، بِجَانِبِ الشَّايِ وَالْقَهْوَة. وَالزَّبَادِي فِي الثَّلَّاجَةِ فِي آخِرِ الْمَحَلّ.
npc.en: The spices are in aisle five, next to the tea and coffee. And the yoghurt is in the fridge at the back of the shop.

choices.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا! لَيْلَى، أَنَا سَآخُذُ الزَّبَادِي، وَأَنْتِ تَأْخُذِينَ الْبَهَارَات، ثُمَّ نَلْتَقِي عِنْدَ الصُّنْدُوق.
choices.en: Thank you very much! Layla, I'll get the yoghurt and you get the spices, then we'll meet at the checkout.
choices.feedback: Good: to Layla it is أَنْتِ تَأْخُذِينَ, the woman's form with -īna.

choices.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا! لَيْلَى، أَنَا سَآخُذُ الزَّبَادِي، وَأَنْتَ تَأْخُذُ الْبَهَارَات، ثُمَّ نَلْتَقِي عِنْدَ الصُّنْدُوق.
choices.en: Thank you very much! Layla, I'll get the yoghurt and you get the spices, then we'll meet at the checkout (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: أَنْتَ تَأْخُذُ is for a man. Layla is a woman: وَأَنْتِ تَأْخُذِينَ الْبَهَارَات.

npc.ar: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر. هَلْ تُرِيدَانِ كِيسًا؟ الْكِيسُ بِجُنَيْهَيْن. تَدْفَعَانِ نَقْدًا أَمْ بِالْبِطَاقَة؟
npc.en: Good evening. Would you two like a bag? A bag costs two pounds. Are you paying in cash or by card?

choices.ar: نَعَم، كِيس وَاحِد، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، وَسَنَدْفَعُ بِالْبِطَاقَة.
choices.en: Yes, one bag, please, and we'll pay by card.
choices.feedback: Good: 'yes' answers the bag question, and بِالْبِطَاقَة answers 'cash or card?'.

choices.ar: نَعَم، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
choices.en: Yes, please.
choices.feedback: His last question is 'cash or card?' (أَمْ), and 'yes' does not answer it. Say نَقْدًا or بِالْبِطَاقَة.

npc.ar: لَحْظَة! لِمَاذَا الْأَرُزّ بِمِئَة وَعِشْرِينَ جُنَيْهًا؟
npc.en: Just a moment! Why is the rice a hundred and twenty pounds?

choices.ar: عَلَى الرَّفِّ مَكْتُوب: كِيسَانِ بِسِتِّينَ جُنَيْهًا. يَعْنِي اثْنَانِ بِسِعْرِ وَاحِد.
choices.en: On the shelf it says two bags for sixty pounds. That means two for the price of one.
choices.feedback: Good: after a tens number like سِتِّينَ the noun is singular with -an: جُنَيْهًا.

choices.ar: عَلَى الرَّفِّ مَكْتُوب: كِيسَانِ بِسِتِّينَ جُنَيْه.
choices.en: On the shelf it says two bags for sixty pounds (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: When a number ends in a tens word like sixty, the noun after it is singular with -an: بِسِتِّينَ جُنَيْهًا.

npc.ar: دَقِيقَة، مِنْ فَضْلِكُمَا، سَأَتَأَكَّدُ مِنَ السِّعْر. آسِف، أَنْتُمَا عَلَى حَقّ: الْعَرْضُ لَمْ يَظْهَرْ فِي النِّظَام.
npc.en: One minute, please, I'll check the price. Sorry, you're right: the offer didn't show up in the system.

choices.ar: لَا مُشْكِلَة، هٰذَا يَحْدُثُ أَحْيَانًا. إِذًا، كَمِ الْمَجْمُوعُ الْآنَ مَعَ الْكِيس؟
choices.en: No problem, that happens sometimes. So how much is the total now, with the bag?
segs: how much (-i links to the next word)
choices.feedback: Friendly and useful. Before al- the sukūn of كَمْ becomes i: كَمِ الْمَجْمُوعُ.

choices.ar: لَا مُشْكِلَة. شُكْرًا لَكَ!
choices.en: No problem. Thank you!
choices.feedback: Polite: the cashier is a man, so شُكْرًا لَكَ with -ka.

choices.ar: لَا مُشْكِلَة. شُكْرًا لَكِ!
choices.en: No problem. Thank you (to a woman)!
choices.feedback: لَكِ (-ki) is for a woman. The cashier is a man (he says آسِف): شُكْرًا لَكَ.

npc.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر! أَهْلًا بِكَ فِي الْمَحَلّ. كَيْفَ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أُسَاعِدَكَ الْيَوْم؟
npc.en: Good morning! Welcome to the shop. How can I help you today?
segs: I help you (to a man, after an)

choices.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور. وَقَعَ هَاتِفِي أَمْسِ فَانْكَسَرَتِ الشَّاشَة، وَالشَّاحِنُ أَيْضًا لَا يَعْمَلُ مُنْذُ أُسْبُوع.
choices.en: Good morning. My phone fell yesterday and the screen cracked, and the charger hasn't worked for a week either.
choices.feedback: Good: شَاشَة is feminine, so the verb takes -at: فَانْكَسَرَتِ الشَّاشَة.

choices.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور. وَقَعَ هَاتِفِي أَمْسِ فَانْكَسَرَ الشَّاشَة.
choices.en: Good morning. My phone fell yesterday and the screen cracked (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: شَاشَة (screen) is feminine, so the past verb needs -at: فَانْكَسَرَتِ الشَّاشَة.

npc.ar: دَعْنِي أَرَى. الشَّاشَةُ مَكْسُورَة فِعْلًا، لٰكِنَّ الْهَاتِفَ نَفْسَهُ سَلِيم. نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نُغَيِّرَ الشَّاشَةَ كُلَّهَا.
npc.en: Let me see. The screen really is cracked, but the phone itself is fine. We can replace the whole screen.

choices.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه! بِكَمِ الْإِصْلَاح؟ وَكَمْ يَوْمًا يَحْتَاجُ؟ أَنَا أَسْتَعْمِلُ الْهَاتِفَ لِلْعَمَلِ كُلَّ يَوْم.
choices.en: Thank God! How much is the repair? And how many days does it take? I use the phone for work every day.
segs: how much (-i links to the next word)
choices.feedback: Good: after كَمْ (how many) the noun is singular with -an: كَمْ يَوْمًا.

choices.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه! بِكَمِ الْإِصْلَاح؟ وَكَمْ أَيَّام يَحْتَاجُ؟
choices.en: Thank God! How much is the repair? And how many days does it take? (wrong ending)
segs: how much (-i links to the next word)
choices.feedback: After كَمْ (how many) the noun is singular and takes -an, never plural: كَمْ يَوْمًا.

npc.ar: الشَّاشَةُ الْجَدِيدَة بِأَلْف وَخَمْسِمِئَةِ جُنَيْه، وَالْإِصْلَاحُ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى يَوْمَيْنِ فَقَط. يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ الْهَاتِفَ يَوْمَ الْخَمِيس.
npc.en: The new screen is one thousand five hundred pounds, and the repair takes only two days. You can collect the phone on Thursday.

choices.ar: هَلْ هُنَاكَ ضَمَان عَلَى الشَّاشَةِ الْجَدِيدَة؟ لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَدْفَعَ مَرَّةً ثَانِيَةً بَعْدَ شَهْر!
choices.en: Is there a warranty on the new screen? I don't want to pay a second time after a month!
choices.feedback: A smart question before you pay. الشَّاشَة is feminine, so 'new' is الْجَدِيدَة.

choices.ar: وَسُؤَال آخَر: أُرِيدُ شَرِيحَةً مَحَلِّيَّةً مَعَ بَاقَةِ إِنْتَرْنِت شَهْرِيَّة. هَلْ تَبِيعُونَ ذٰلِكَ هُنَا؟
choices.en: And another question: I want a local SIM card with a monthly internet package. Do you sell that here?
choices.feedback: Good: شَرِيحَة is feminine, so 'local' is مَحَلِّيَّةً, with the same -an as the object.

choices.ar: هَلْ هُنَاكَ ضَمَان عَلَى الشَّاشَةِ الْجَدِيدِ؟
choices.en: Is there a warranty on the new screen? (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: شَاشَة (screen) is feminine, so the adjective needs ة: الشَّاشَةِ الْجَدِيدَة.

npc.ar: طَبْعًا، الضَّمَانُ سِتَّةُ أَشْهُر. وَبِالنِّسْبَةِ لِلشَّاحِن، الْأَفْضَلُ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ شَاحِنًا جَدِيدًا. هٰذَا بِثَلَاثِمِئَةِ جُنَيْه.
npc.en: Of course, the warranty is six months. As for the charger, it's better to buy a new one. This one is three hundred pounds.
segs: and as for (lit. and in relation)

choices.ar: سَآخُذُهُ. وَسُؤَال آخَر: أُرِيدُ شَرِيحَةً مَحَلِّيَّةً مَعَ بَاقَةِ إِنْتَرْنِت شَهْرِيَّة. هَلْ تَبِيعُونَ ذٰلِكَ هُنَا؟
choices.en: I'll take it. And another question: I want a local SIM card with a monthly internet package. Do you sell that here?
choices.feedback: Good: سَآخُذُهُ, with -hu for the charger (شَاحِن, masculine), and مَحَلِّيَّةً agrees with شَرِيحَةً.

choices.ar: سَآخُذُهُ. وَسُؤَال آخَر: أُرِيدُ شَرِيحَةً مَحَلِّيًّا مَعَ بَاقَةِ إِنْتَرْنِت شَهْرِيَّة.
choices.en: I'll take it. And another question: I want a local SIM card with a monthly internet package (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: شَرِيحَة (SIM card) is feminine, so its adjective is feminine too: شَرِيحَةً مَحَلِّيَّةً.

npc.ar: نَعَم، وَالشَّرِيحَةُ نَفْسُهَا مَجَّانِيَّة. عِنْدَنَا بَاقَةُ عِشْرِينَ جِيجَابَايْت بِمِئَتَيْنِ وَخَمْسِينَ جُنَيْهًا فِي الشَّهْر، وَبَاقَةُ أَرْبَعِينَ جِيجَابَايْت بِأَرْبَعِمِئَةِ جُنَيْه.
npc.en: Yes, and the SIM card itself is free. We have a twenty-gigabyte package for two hundred and fifty pounds a month, and a forty-gigabyte package for four hundred pounds.

choices.ar: بَاقَةُ الْعِشْرِينَ تَكْفِينِي، لِأَنِّي أَسْتَعْمِلُ الْإِنْتَرْنِتَ فِي الْبَيْتِ أَكْثَر. مَاذَا تَحْتَاجُ مِنِّي لِلشَّرِيحَة؟
choices.en: The twenty package is enough for me, because I use the internet at home more. What do you need from me for the SIM card?
choices.feedback: Good: بَاقَة is feminine, so the verb is تَكْفِينِي with t-.

choices.ar: بَاقَةُ الْعِشْرِينَ يَكْفِينِي، لِأَنِّي أَسْتَعْمِلُ الْإِنْتَرْنِتَ فِي الْبَيْتِ أَكْثَر.
choices.en: The twenty package is enough for me, because I use the internet at home more (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: بَاقَة (package) is feminine, so the verb starts with t-: بَاقَةُ الْعِشْرِينَ تَكْفِينِي.

npc.ar: جَوَازُ سَفَرِكَ فَقَط، لِأَنَّ الْقَانُونَ يَطْلُبُ تَسْجِيلَ كُلِّ شَرِيحَة بِاسْمِ صَاحِبِهَا. سَيَعْمَلُ الْإِنْتَرْنِتُ بَعْدَ سَاعَة تَقْرِيبًا.
npc.en: Only your passport, because the law requires every SIM card to be registered in its owner's name. The internet will work in about an hour.

choices.ar: تَفَضَّلْ، هٰذَا جَوَازُ سَفَرِي.
choices.en: Here you are, this is my passport.
choices.feedback: Good: تَفَضَّلْ to the seller, a man, and هٰذَا because جَوَاز is masculine.

choices.ar: تَفَضَّلِي، هٰذَا جَوَازُ سَفَرِي.
choices.en: Here you are (to a woman), this is my passport.
choices.feedback: تَفَضَّلِي is said to a woman. The seller is a man: تَفَضَّلْ.

choices.ar: تَفَضَّلْ، هٰذِهِ جَوَازُ سَفَرِي.
choices.en: Here you are, this is my passport (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: جَوَاز (passport) is masculine, so 'this' is هٰذَا: هٰذَا جَوَازُ سَفَرِي.

npc.ar: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر وَأَهْلًا بِكُمَا! هَلْ أَنْتُمَا مُسْتَعِدَّانِ لِلطَّلَب، أَمْ تُرِيدَانِ وَقْتًا أَكْثَر؟
npc.en: Good evening and welcome to you both! Are you two ready to order, or would you like more time?

choices.ar: مَسَاءُ النُّور. قَبْلَ أَنْ نَطْلُبَ، يَجِبُ أَنْ أَقُولَ شَيْئَيْنِ مُهِمَّيْنِ: زَمِيلِي نَبَاتِيّ، وَأَنَا عِنْدِي حَسَاسِيَّة مِنَ الْمُكَسَّرَات.
choices.en: Good evening. Before we order, I must tell you two important things: my colleague is vegetarian, and I have a nut allergy.
choices.feedback: Good: you 'have' an allergy, عِنْدِي حَسَاسِيَّة, and you say it before ordering.

choices.ar: مَسَاءُ النُّور. زَمِيلِي نَبَاتِيّ، وَأَنَا حَسَاسِيَّة مِنَ الْمُكَسَّرَات.
choices.en: Good evening. My colleague is vegetarian, and I am an allergy to nuts (wrong form).
choices.feedback: أَنَا حَسَاسِيَّة means 'I am an allergy'. In Arabic you have an allergy: عِنْدِي حَسَاسِيَّة مِنَ الْمُكَسَّرَات.

choices.ar: نَعَم.
choices.en: Yes.
choices.feedback: He asks 'ready, or more time?' (أَمْ), so 'yes' does not answer. And tell him about the allergy before you order.

npc.ar: لَا مُشْكِلَة أَبَدًا، شُكْرًا لِأَنَّكَ أَخْبَرْتَنِي. سَأَكْتُبُ ذٰلِكَ لِلْمَطْبَخ. مَاذَا تُرِيدَانِ أَنْ تَعْرِفَا؟
npc.en: No problem at all, thank you for telling me. I'll write that down for the kitchen. What would you two like to know?

choices.ar: هَلْ فِي السَّلَطَةِ مُكَسَّرَات؟ وَهَلِ الْأَرُزُّ مَطْبُوخ بِمَرَقِ اللَّحْم؟ زَمِيلِي لَا يَأْكُلُ لَحْمًا وَلَا دَجَاجًا وَلَا سَمَكًا.
choices.en: Are there nuts in the salad? And is the rice cooked with meat stock? My colleague doesn't eat meat, chicken or fish.
choices.feedback: Careful questions. The objects of يَأْكُلُ take -an: لَحْمًا، دَجَاجًا، سَمَكًا.

choices.ar: هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ طَبَق رَئِيسِيّ نَبَاتِيّ؟ أَقْصِدُ طَبَقًا كَامِلًا، لَيْسَ سَلَطَةً فَقَطْ. وَهَلِ الطَّعَامُ حَلَال؟
choices.en: Do you have a vegetarian main course? I mean a full dish, not just a salad. And is the food halal?
choices.feedback: Good: the predicate of لَيْسَ takes -an: لَيْسَ سَلَطَةً فَقَطْ.

choices.ar: هَلْ فِي السَّلَطَةِ مُكَسَّرَات؟ زَمِيلِي لَا يَأْكُلُ لَحْم.
choices.en: Are there nuts in the salad? My colleague doesn't eat meat (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: The object of يَأْكُلُ is indefinite and takes -an: زَمِيلِي لَا يَأْكُلُ لَحْمًا.

npc.ar: السَّلَطَةُ بِدُونِ مُكَسَّرَات، لٰكِنَّ الْأَرُزَّ مَطْبُوخ بِمَرَقِ الدَّجَاج. عِنْدَنَا أَرُزّ عَادِيّ بِالْمَاء إِذَا أَرَدْتُمَا.
npc.en: The salad has no nuts, but the rice is cooked with chicken stock. We have plain rice cooked in water if you two want.

choices.ar: مُمْتَاز. هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ طَبَق رَئِيسِيّ نَبَاتِيّ؟ أَقْصِدُ طَبَقًا كَامِلًا، لَيْسَ سَلَطَةً فَقَطْ. وَهَلِ الطَّعَامُ حَلَال؟
choices.en: Excellent. Do you have a vegetarian main course? I mean a full dish, not just a salad. And is the food halal?
choices.feedback: Good: عِنْدَكُمْ (plural) asks about the restaurant, and لَيْسَ makes سَلَطَةً take -an.

choices.ar: مُمْتَاز. هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ طَبَق رَئِيسِيّ نَبَاتِيّ؟ أَقْصِدُ طَبَقًا كَامِلًا، لَيْسَ سَلَطَة فَقَطْ.
choices.en: Excellent. Do you have a vegetarian main course? I mean a full dish, not just a salad (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: The predicate of لَيْسَ takes -an: لَيْسَ سَلَطَةً فَقَطْ.

npc.ar: طَبْعًا، كُلُّ طَعَامِنَا حَلَال. وَعِنْدَنَا مَقْلُوبَة بِالْخُضَار بِدُونِ لَحْم، وَفَلَافِل مَعَ حُمُّص وَخُبْز سَاخِن.
npc.en: Of course, all our food is halal. And we have maqluba with vegetables and no meat, and falafel with hummus and hot bread.

choices.ar: الْمَقْلُوبَة لِزَمِيلِي، إِذًا. وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ الْمُسَخَّن، لٰكِنْ هَلْ فِيهِ مُكَسَّرَات؟ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ اسْأَلِ الْمَطْبَخ.
choices.en: Maqluba for my colleague, then. And I'd like the musakhan, but does it have nuts in it? Please ask the kitchen.
segs: the musakhan (chicken on bread with onions and sumac)
ask (to a man; -i links to the next word)
choices.feedback: Good: an order to the waiter softened with مِنْ فَضْلِكَ, and you check the nuts again.

choices.ar: الْمَقْلُوبَة لِزَمِيلِي، إِذًا. وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ الْمُسَخَّن، لٰكِنْ هَلْ فِيهِ مُكَسَّرَات؟ اسْأَلِ الْمَطْبَخ!
choices.en: Maqluba for my colleague, then. And I'd like the musakhan, but does it have nuts in it? Ask the kitchen!
segs: the musakhan (chicken on bread with onions and sumac)
ask (to a man; -i links to the next word)
choices.feedback: اسْأَلِ الْمَطْبَخ with no 'please' sounds like an order to the waiter. Say مِنْ فَضْلِكَ اسْأَلِ الْمَطْبَخ.

npc.ar: لِلْأَسَف، نَعَم. الْمُسَخَّنُ عِنْدَنَا عَلَيْهِ صَنَوْبَر وَلَوْز. أَنْصَحُكَ بِالسَّمَكِ الْمَشْوِيّ، أَوْ نُحَضِّرُ لَكَ الْمُسَخَّنَ بِدُونِ مُكَسَّرَات.
npc.en: Unfortunately, yes. Our musakhan has pine nuts and almonds on top. I recommend the grilled fish, or we can prepare the musakhan for you without nuts.

choices.ar: الْمُسَخَّن بِدُونِ مُكَسَّرَات، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. لٰكِنْ هَلْ هُوَ آمِن حَقًّا؟ حَسَاسِيَّتِي شَدِيدَة، وَحَتَّى الْكَمِّيَّةُ الصَّغِيرَةُ تُسَبِّبُ لِي مُشْكِلَة.
choices.en: The musakhan without nuts, please. But is it really safe? My allergy is severe, and even a small amount causes me a problem.
segs: the musakhan (chicken on bread with onions and sumac)
choices.feedback: Good: with a severe allergy it is right to ask again. حَسَاسِيَّة is feminine, so شَدِيدَة and تُسَبِّبُ.

choices.ar: الْمُسَخَّن بِدُونِ مُكَسَّرَات، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. حَسَاسِيَّتِي شَدِيد.
choices.en: The musakhan without nuts, please. My allergy is severe (wrong ending).
segs: the musakhan (chicken on bread with onions and sumac)
choices.feedback: حَسَاسِيَّة (allergy) is feminine, so the adjective needs ة: حَسَاسِيَّتِي شَدِيدَة.

npc.ar: سَأَتَأَكَّدُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ مَعَ الطَّبَّاخِ بِنَفْسِي، وَسَيُحَضِّرُهُ بَعِيدًا عَنِ الْمُكَسَّرَات. وَمَاذَا تَشْرَبَانِ؟
npc.en: I will check that with the cook myself, and he will prepare it away from the nuts. And what will you two drink?
segs: from, away from (-i links to the next word)

choices.ar: عَصِيرَ لَيْمُون بِالنَّعْنَاع لِزَمِيلِي، بِدُونِ سُكَّر مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ مَاءً فَقَطْ.
choices.en: A lemon and mint juice for my colleague, with no sugar please. And I just want water.
choices.feedback: Good: مَاءً takes -an as the object of أُرِيدُ.

choices.ar: عَصِيرَ لَيْمُون بِالنَّعْنَاع لِزَمِيلِي، بِدُونِ سُكَّر مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ مَاء فَقَطْ.
choices.en: A lemon and mint juice for my colleague, with no sugar please. And I just want water (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: The object of أُرِيدُ takes -an: أُرِيدُ مَاءً فَقَطْ.

npc.ar: أَهْلًا يَا فَيْصَل! كَيْفَ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أُسَاعِدَكَ؟
npc.en: Hi, Faisal! How can I help you?
segs: I help you (to a man, after an)

choices.ar: يَا لَيْلَى، أَحْتَاجُ إِلَى نَصِيحَتِكِ. وَالِدَا سَامِي دَعَوَانِي إِلَى الْعَشَاء غَدًا، وَهٰذِهِ أَوَّلُ مَرَّة أَزُورُ بَيْتَهُمَا.
choices.en: Layla, I need your advice. Sami's parents have invited me to dinner tomorrow, and it's the first time I'm visiting their house.
choices.feedback: Good: نَصِيحَتِكِ with -ki, because Layla is a woman, and the dual دَعَوَانِي for the two parents.

choices.ar: يَا لَيْلَى، أَحْتَاجُ إِلَى نَصِيحَتِكَ. وَالِدَا سَامِي دَعَوَانِي إِلَى الْعَشَاء غَدًا.
choices.en: Layla, I need your advice (to a man). Sami's parents have invited me to dinner tomorrow.
choices.feedback: -ka is 'your' to a man. Layla is a woman: نَصِيحَتِكِ (-ki).

npc.ar: جَمِيل! لَا تَقْلَقْ، الْأَمْرُ سَهْل. أَوَّلًا، مَاذَا سَتَحْمِلُ مَعَكَ كَهَدِيَّة؟
npc.en: Lovely! Don't worry, it's easy. First of all, what are you going to take with you as a gift?
segs: you will carry, take (to a man)

choices.ar: اِشْتَرَيْتُ زُجَاجَةَ نَبِيذ مِنَ السُّوبَرْمَارْكِت. هٰذَا مَا نَفْعَلُهُ عَادَةً فِي أَمْرِيكَا.
choices.en: I bought a bottle of wine from the supermarket. That's what we usually do in America.
choices.feedback: Correct Arabic and an honest answer, and Layla will tell you what fits better here. Note عَادَةً with adverbial -an.

choices.ar: سَأَشْتَرِي عُلْبَةَ بَقْلَاوَة مِنْ مَحَلِّ الْحَلَوِيَّات. وَهَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ أَصِلَ فِي الْوَقْتِ بِالضَّبْط؟
choices.en: I'll buy a box of baklava from the sweet shop. And do I have to arrive exactly on time?
choices.feedback: A good gift for a family dinner. سَ + أَشْتَرِي: 'I will buy'.

choices.ar: سَتَشْتَرِي عُلْبَةَ بَقْلَاوَة مِنْ مَحَلِّ الْحَلَوِيَّات.
choices.en: You will buy a box of baklava from the sweet shop (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: Layla asks with سَتَحْمِلُ (you will take), but you answer about yourself: سَأَشْتَرِي (I will buy), with سَأَ-.

npc.ar: لَا، لَا! النَّبِيذُ هَدِيَّة غَيْرُ مُنَاسِبَة هُنَا، وَوَالِدَا سَامِي لَا يَشْرَبَانِ. خُذْ عُلْبَةَ بَقْلَاوَة أَوْ فَاكِهَة بَدَلًا مِنْهُ.
npc.en: No, no! Wine is not a suitable gift here, and Sami's parents don't drink. Take a box of baklava or some fruit instead.

choices.ar: فِكْرَة مُمْتَازَة، سَأَشْتَرِي الْبَقْلَاوَة مِنْ مَحَلِّ الْحَلَوِيَّات. وَهَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ أَصِلَ فِي الْوَقْتِ بِالضَّبْط؟
choices.en: Excellent idea, I'll buy the baklava from the sweet shop. And do I have to arrive exactly on time?
choices.feedback: Good: فِكْرَة is feminine, so مُمْتَازَة. After يَجِبُ أَنْ the verb ends in -a: أَصِلَ.

choices.ar: فِكْرَة مُمْتَاز، سَأَشْتَرِي الْبَقْلَاوَة مِنْ مَحَلِّ الْحَلَوِيَّات.
choices.en: Excellent idea, I'll buy the baklava from the sweet shop (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: فِكْرَة (idea) is feminine, so the adjective needs ة: فِكْرَة مُمْتَازَة.

npc.ar: التَّأَخُّرُ عَشْرَ دَقَائِقَ أَمْرٌ عَادِيّ. وَعِنْدَ الْبَاب، إِذَا خَلَعَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ أَحْذِيَتَهُمْ فَاخْلَعْ حِذَاءَكَ أَيْضًا.
npc.en: Being ten minutes late is normal. And at the door, if the hosts take off their shoes, take off your shoes too.

choices.ar: وَعَلَى الْمَائِدَة؟ سَمِعْتُ أَنَّ النَّاسَ يَأْكُلُونَ بِالْيَدِ الْيُمْنَى فَقَطْ.
choices.en: And at the table? I heard that people eat with the right hand only.
choices.feedback: Good: يَد (hand) is feminine, so 'right' is الْيُمْنَى; and after أَنَّ the noun takes -a: النَّاسَ.

choices.ar: وَعَلَى الْمَائِدَة؟ سَمِعْتُ أَنَّ النَّاسَ يَأْكُلُونَ بِالْيَدِ الْيَمِين فَقَطْ.
choices.en: And at the table? I heard that people eat with the right hand only (wrong form).
choices.feedback: الْيَمِين is the noun 'the right side', as in 'on the right'. With يَد (feminine) use the adjective: بِالْيَدِ الْيُمْنَى.

npc.ar: صَحِيح، الْيَدُ الْيُمْنَى لِلْأَكْل. وَعِنْدَمَا تَقُولُ لَكَ الْأُمُّ «تَفَضَّلْ»، خُذْ مِنْ كُلِّ طَبَق وَامْدَحِ الطَّعَام.
npc.en: Right, the right hand is for eating. And when the mother says to you 'please, go ahead', take some of every dish and praise the food.
segs: and praise! (to a man; -i links to the next word)

choices.ar: وَإِذَا أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَمْلَأَ صَحْنِي لِلْمَرَّةِ الثَّالِثَة؟ لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ آكُلَ كُلَّ هٰذَا!
choices.en: And if she wants to fill my plate for the third time? I can't eat all of that!
choices.feedback: Good: the mother is 'she', so أَرَادَتْ with -at and تَمْلَأَ with t-.

choices.ar: وَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ تَمْلَأَ صَحْنِي لِلْمَرَّةِ الثَّالِثَة؟
choices.en: And if he wants to fill my plate for the third time? (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: You mean the mother, so the verb is feminine: وَإِذَا أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَمْلَأَ صَحْنِي.

npc.ar: اِبْتَسِمْ وَقُلْ: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه، شَبِعْتُ، الطَّعَامُ كَانَ لَذِيذًا جِدًّا. سَتَفْهَمُ وَلَنْ تُصِرَّ.
npc.en: Smile and say: thank God, I'm full, the food was very delicious. She will understand and won't insist.
segs: I am full (lit. I became full)

choices.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه، شَبِعْتُ، الطَّعَامُ كَانَ لَذِيذًا جِدًّا.
choices.en: Thank God, I'm full, the food was very delicious.
segs: I am full (lit. I became full)
choices.feedback: Good practice: after كَانَ the predicate takes -an: كَانَ لَذِيذًا.

choices.ar: فَهِمْتُ، شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا يَا لَيْلَى!
choices.en: Got it, thank you very much, Layla!
choices.feedback: A warm way to finish: فَهِمْتُ with -tu is 'I understood'.

choices.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه، شَبِعْتُ، الطَّعَامُ كَانَ لَذِيذ جِدًّا.
choices.en: Thank God, I'm full, the food was very delicious (wrong ending).
segs: I am full (lit. I became full)
choices.feedback: After كَانَ the predicate takes -an: الطَّعَامُ كَانَ لَذِيذًا جِدًّا.

npc.ar: أَهْلًا يَا فَيْصَل! مَا الْمُشْكِلَة؟
npc.en: Hi, Faisal! What's the problem?

choices.ar: هٰذِهِ الْآلَة لَا تَأْخُذُ وَرَقَتِي، وَأَنَا لَا أَعْرِفُ كَمْ مَحَطَّة بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الْمَتْحَف.
choices.en: This machine won't take my banknote, and I don't know how many stations there are between us and the museum.
choices.feedback: Good: آلَة is feminine, so هٰذِهِ and تَأْخُذُ; and after كَمْ the noun is singular: كَمْ مَحَطَّة.

choices.ar: هٰذِهِ الْآلَة لَا يَأْخُذُ وَرَقَتِي.
choices.en: This machine won't take my banknote (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: آلَة (machine) is feminine, so the verb is feminine too: لَا تَأْخُذُ, not يَأْخُذُ.

choices.ar: هٰذِهِ الْآلَة لَا تَأْخُذُ وَرَقَتِي، وَأَنَا لَا أَعْرِفُ كَمْ مَحَطَّات بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الْمَتْحَف.
choices.en: This machine won't take my banknote, and I don't know how many stations there are between us and the museum (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: After كَمْ (how many) the noun is singular, never plural: كَمْ مَحَطَّة.

npc.ar: الْمَتْحَفُ الْمِصْرِيّ فِي مَحَطَّةِ السَّادَات، وَهِيَ الْمَحَطَّةُ الرَّابِعَة مِنْ هُنَا. اِخْتَرِ التَّذْكِرَةَ الْأُولَى: حَتَّى تِسْعِ مَحَطَّات بِثَمَانِيَةِ جُنَيْهَات.
npc.en: The Egyptian Museum is at Sadat station, and that's the fourth station from here. Choose the first ticket: up to nine stations for eight pounds.
segs: choose (to a man; -i links to the next word)

choices.ar: اِخْتَرْتُهَا. وَالْآنَ، أَيْنَ أَضَعُ النُّقُود؟ أَرَى فَتْحَةً لِلْعُمْلَاتِ الْمَعْدَنِيَّةِ وَفَتْحَةً أُخْرَى، وَلَا أَعْرِفُ أَيُّهُمَا لِلْوَرَقَة.
choices.en: I've chosen it. And now, where do I put the money? I see a slot for coins and another slot, and I don't know which of the two is for the note.
choices.feedback: Good: -hā in اِخْتَرْتُهَا, because تَذْكِرَة (ticket) is feminine.

choices.ar: اِخْتَرْتُهَا. حَاوَلْتُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّات، وَكُلَّ مَرَّة تَرُدُّ الْآلَةُ الْوَرَقَةَ إِلَيَّ!
choices.en: I've chosen it. I've tried three times, and every time the machine gives the note back to me!
choices.feedback: Good: مَرَّة is feminine, so 'three' has no ة: ثَلَاثَ مَرَّات.

choices.ar: اِخْتَرْتُهُ. وَالْآنَ، أَيْنَ أَضَعُ النُّقُود؟
choices.en: I've chosen it. And now, where do I put the money? (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: تَذْكِرَة (ticket) is feminine, so 'it' is -hā: اِخْتَرْتُهَا.

npc.ar: الْفَتْحَةُ الْعَرِيضَة لِلْوَرَقَة. ضَعِ الْوَرَقَةَ مَبْسُوطَةً، لِأَنَّ الْآلَةَ لَا تَقْبَلُ الْوَرَقَ الْمَطْوِيَّ أَوِ الْمُجَعَّد.
npc.en: The wide slot is for the note. Put the note in flat, because the machine doesn't accept folded or crumpled paper.
segs: put (to a man; -i links to the next word)
or (-i links to the next word)

choices.ar: حَاوَلْتُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّات، وَكُلَّ مَرَّة تَرُدُّ الْآلَةُ الْوَرَقَةَ إِلَيَّ! أَظُنُّ أَنَّهَا مُجَعَّدَة جِدًّا مِنْ جَيْبِي.
choices.en: I've tried three times, and every time the machine gives the note back to me! I think it's too crumpled from being in my pocket.
choices.feedback: Good: وَرَقَة is feminine, so أَنَّهَا and مُجَعَّدَة.

choices.ar: حَاوَلْتُ ثَلَاثَةَ مَرَّات، وَكُلَّ مَرَّة تَرُدُّ الْآلَةُ الْوَرَقَةَ إِلَيَّ!
choices.en: I've tried three times, and every time the machine gives the note back to me! (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: With 3 to 10 the number takes the opposite gender. مَرَّة is feminine, so 'three' has no ة: ثَلَاثَ مَرَّات.

npc.ar: لَا مُشْكِلَة. هَلْ مَعَكَ عُمْلَات مَعْدَنِيَّة أَوْ بِطَاقَة بَنْكِيَّة؟ الْآلَةُ تَقْبَلُ الْبِطَاقَاتَ أَيْضًا، اِضْغَطْ عَلَى زِرِّ الْبِطَاقَة.
npc.en: No problem. Do you have coins or a bank card with you? The machine takes cards too, press the card button.

choices.ar: ضَغَطْتُ عَلَيْهِ، لٰكِنَّ الشَّاشَةَ الْآنَ تَقُولُ إِنَّ الْآلَةَ لَا تَعْمَل وَإِنَّ عَلَيَّ أَنْ أَسْتَعْمِلَ آلَةً أُخْرَى!
choices.en: I pressed it, but now the screen says that the machine isn't working and that I have to use another machine!
choices.feedback: Good: after قَالَ 'that' is إِنَّ, and its noun takes -a: إِنَّ الْآلَةَ لَا تَعْمَل.

choices.ar: ضَغَطْتُ عَلَيْهِ، لٰكِنَّ الشَّاشَةَ الْآنَ تَقُولُ إِنَّ الْآلَةَ لَا يَعْمَل!
choices.en: I pressed it, but now the screen says that the machine isn't working! (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: آلَة (machine) is feminine, so the verb must be feminine too: الْآلَةَ لَا تَعْمَل.

npc.ar: هٰذَا يَحْدُثُ كَثِيرًا فِي سَاعَةِ الذُّرْوَة. تَعَالَ، الْآلَةُ الثَّانِيَة هُنَاكَ تَعْمَل، أَوْ نَذْهَبُ إِلَى شُبَّاكِ التَّذَاكِرِ عِنْدَ الْمَدْخَل.
npc.en: That happens a lot in the rush hour. Come on, the second machine over there is working, or we go to the ticket window by the entrance.

choices.ar: الْآلَةُ الثَّانِيَة أَخَذَتْ وَرَقَةَ الْعِشْرِينَ جُنَيْهًا فَوْرًا! سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا، فَمَاذَا أَفْعَلُ الْآنَ؟
choices.en: The second machine took the twenty-pound note straight away! I heard a sound, so what do I do now?
choices.feedback: Good: the machine is feminine, so الثَّانِيَة and أَخَذَتْ with -at.

choices.ar: الْآلَةُ الثَّانِي أَخَذَتْ وَرَقَةَ الْعِشْرِينَ جُنَيْهًا فَوْرًا!
choices.en: The second machine took the twenty-pound note straight away! (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: آلَة is feminine, so 'second' is feminine too: الْآلَةُ الثَّانِيَة.

npc.ar: خُذِ التَّذْكِرَةَ مِنَ الْفَتْحَةِ السُّفْلَى، وَلَا تَنْسَ الْبَاقِي، اِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ جُنَيْهًا، فِي الصُّنْدُوقِ الصَّغِيرِ تَحْتَهَا.
npc.en: Take the ticket from the lower slot, and don't forget the change, twelve pounds, in the little tray underneath it.
segs: take (to a man; -i links to the next word)

choices.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا يَا سَامِي!
choices.en: Thank you very much, Sami!
choices.feedback: Good: يَا before a name when you speak to someone.

choices.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا يَا سَامِي! وَمَاذَا أَفْعَلُ بِالتَّذْكِرَةِ عِنْدَ الْبَوَّابَة؟
choices.en: Thank you very much, Sami! And what do I do with the ticket at the gate?
choices.feedback: A useful next question: مَاذَا أَفْعَلُ بِـ … 'what do I do with …'.

choices.ar: شُكْرًا لَكِ يَا سَامِي!
choices.en: Thank you (to a woman), Sami!
choices.feedback: لَكِ (-ki) is for a woman. Sami is a man: شُكْرًا لَكَ يَا سَامِي.

npc.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر، أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا بِكَ فِي الْمَعْهَد. كَيْفَ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أُسَاعِدَكَ؟
npc.en: Good morning, welcome to the institute. How can I help you?
segs: I help you (to a man, after an)

choices.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور. أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَجِّلَ فِي دَوْرَةِ لُغَة عَرَبِيَّة، لِأَنِّي سَأَبْقَى فِي عَمَّان سِتَّةَ أَشْهُر لِلْعَمَل.
choices.en: Good morning. I want to enrol in an Arabic language course, because I'll be staying in Amman for six months for work.
choices.feedback: Good: after أَنْ the verb ends in -a: أُسَجِّلَ.

choices.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور. أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَجِّلُ فِي دَوْرَةِ لُغَة عَرَبِيَّة.
choices.en: Good morning. I want to enrol in an Arabic language course (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: After أَنْ the verb takes -a, not -u: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَجِّلَ.

npc.ar: إِذًا سَنُعْطِيكَ امْتِحَانَ تَحْدِيدِ الْمُسْتَوَى الْقَصِير، وَبَعْدَهُ نَضَعُكَ فِي الْمُسْتَوَى الْمُنَاسِب. عِنْدَنَا سِتَّةُ مُسْتَوَيَات.
npc.en: Then we'll give you the short placement test, and after it we'll put you in the right level. We have six levels.
segs: we will give you (to a man)

choices.ar: مُمْتَاز. وَمَا هِيَ أَيَّامُ الدُّرُوسِ وَأَوْقَاتُهَا؟ أَنَا أَعْمَلُ مِنَ الْعَاشِرَةِ حَتَّى السَّادِسَة، فَالْمَسَاءُ أَفْضَلُ لِي.
choices.en: Excellent. And what are the days and times of the classes? I work from ten to six, so the evening is better for me.
choices.feedback: Good: أَيَّام is a plural of things, so it takes هِيَ and -hā: وَأَوْقَاتُهَا.

choices.ar: مُمْتَاز. وَمَا هُمْ أَيَّامُ الدُّرُوسِ وَأَوْقَاتُهُمْ؟
choices.en: Excellent. And what are the days and times of the classes? (wrong ending)
choices.feedback: هُمْ and -hum are only for people. Plurals of things count as feminine singular: وَمَا هِيَ أَيَّامُ الدُّرُوسِ وَأَوْقَاتُهَا؟

npc.ar: دُرُوسُ الْمَسَاءِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْأَرْبِعَاء مِنَ السَّادِسَةِ حَتَّى الثَّامِنَة، لٰكِنَّ هٰذِهِ الْمَجْمُوعَةَ مُمْتَلِئَة لِلْأَسَف.
npc.en: The evening classes are on Monday and Wednesday from six to eight, but unfortunately that group is full.

choices.ar: يَا لَلْخَسَارَة! هَلْ هُنَاكَ حَلٌّ آخَر؟ لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنْتَظِرَ شَهْرًا كَامِلًا بِدُونِ دُرُوس.
choices.en: What a pity! Is there another solution? I don't want to wait a whole month without lessons.
choices.feedback: Polite and clear. شَهْرًا كَامِلًا: the time phrase takes -an, and so does its adjective.

choices.ar: يَا لَلْخَسَارَة! هَلْ هُنَاكَ حَلٌّ آخَر؟ لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنْتَظِرَ شَهْر كَامِل بِدُونِ دُرُوس.
choices.en: What a pity! Is there another solution? I don't want to wait a whole month without lessons (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: 'A whole month' as a length of time takes -an: أَنْتَظِرَ شَهْرًا كَامِلًا.

npc.ar: عِنْدَكَ خِيَارَانِ: مَجْمُوعَةُ الصَّبَاحِ يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ وَالثُّلَاثَاء مِنَ السَّابِعَةِ حَتَّى التَّاسِعَة، أَوْ نَضَعُ اسْمَكَ عَلَى قَائِمَةِ الِانْتِظَار لِلْمَسَاء.
npc.en: You have two options: the morning group on Sunday and Tuesday from seven to nine, or we put your name on the waiting list for the evening.
segs: you have (to a man, lit. at you)

choices.ar: السَّابِعَةُ صَبَاحًا مُبَكِّرَة قَلِيلًا، لٰكِنَّ مَكْتَبِي قَرِيب مِنْ هُنَا. سَأَخْتَارُ مَجْمُوعَةَ الصَّبَاح. وَكَمِ الرَّسْم؟
choices.en: Seven in the morning is a little early, but my office is near here. I'll choose the morning group. And how much is the fee?
segs: and how much (-i links to the next word)
choices.feedback: Good: السَّابِعَة (seven o'clock) is feminine, so 'early' is مُبَكِّرَة.

choices.ar: سَأَخْتَارُ مَجْمُوعَةَ الصَّبَاح. هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ أَدْفَعَ الْيَوْم؟
choices.en: I'll choose the morning group. Do I have to pay today?
choices.feedback: Good: a clear choice, and يَجِبُ أَنْ with the verb in -a: أَدْفَعَ.

choices.ar: السَّابِعَةُ صَبَاحًا مُبَكِّر قَلِيلًا. سَأَخْتَارُ مَجْمُوعَةَ الصَّبَاح.
choices.en: Seven in the morning is a little early. I'll choose the morning group (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: السَّابِعَة ('seven o'clock', the seventh hour) is feminine, so the adjective needs ة: مُبَكِّرَة.

npc.ar: الرَّسْمُ مِئَة وَعِشْرُونَ دِينَارًا فِي الشَّهْر، وَالْكِتَابُ بِخَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ دِينَارًا. الصَّفُّ فِي الطَّابِقِ الثَّانِي، وَفِيهِ ثَمَانِيَةُ طُلَّاب فَقَط.
npc.en: The fee is a hundred and twenty dinars a month, and the textbook is fifteen dinars. The classroom is on the second floor, and there are only eight students in it.

choices.ar: السِّعْرُ مَعْقُول. هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ أَدْفَعَ كُلَّ الْمَبْلَغِ الْيَوْم، أَمْ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَدْفَعَ عُرْبُونًا الْآنَ وَالْبَاقِيَ فِي أَوَّلِ دَرْس؟
choices.en: The price is reasonable. Do I have to pay the whole amount today, or can I pay a deposit now and the rest at the first lesson?
segs: I can (lit. it is possible for me)
choices.feedback: Good: هَلْ … أَمْ asks 'this or that?', and both objects of أَدْفَعَ carry their ending: عُرْبُونًا … وَالْبَاقِيَ.

choices.ar: السِّعْرُ مَعْقُولَة.
choices.en: The price is reasonable (wrong ending).
choices.feedback: سِعْر (price) is masculine, so the adjective has no ة: السِّعْرُ مَعْقُول.

npc.ar: طَبْعًا، عُرْبُونُ ثَلَاثِينَ دِينَارًا يَحْفَظُ مَكَانَكَ. أَكْتُبُ اسْمَكَ الْآنَ، وَامْتِحَانُ الْمُسْتَوَى غَدًا فِي التَّاسِعَة. أَهْلًا بِكَ فِي مَعْهَدِنَا!
npc.en: Of course, a deposit of thirty dinars keeps your place. I'll write your name down now, and the level test is tomorrow at nine. Welcome to our institute!

choices.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا! تَفَضَّلِي، هٰذَا الْعُرْبُون. سَأَكُونُ هُنَا غَدًا فِي التَّاسِعَةِ تَمَامًا.
choices.en: Thank you very much! Here you are, this is the deposit. I'll be here tomorrow at nine exactly.
choices.feedback: Good: the clerk is a woman, so تَفَضَّلِي with -ī. تَمَامًا is adverbial -an.

choices.ar: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا! تَفَضَّلْ، هٰذَا الْعُرْبُون.
choices.en: Thank you very much! Here you are (to a man), this is the deposit.
choices.feedback: تَفَضَّلْ is said to a man. The clerk is a woman: تَفَضَّلِي.
